FilingSource.description: Which adapter saw the filing, and at which URI.

adapter.description: Ingestion adapter that observed the filing.
adapter.title: Adapter

source_uri.description: The EDGAR URI the adapter read. For daily-index this is the full submission text file; for current-feed it is the filing index page.
source_uri.title: Source Uri

FilingSource.title: FilingSource

description: A filing observed on EDGAR, before anything has been downloaded.

cik.description: Zero-padded CIK of the filer the index attributed.
cik.title: Cik

event_id.description: sha256 of the accession number, prefixed "sha256:". Stable from discovery onward and identical across adapters, so the same filing seen twice deduplicates to one event.
event_id.title: Event Id

idempotency_key.description: sha256 of "<adapter>|<accession_number>", prefixed "sha256:". Distinguishes a redelivery of one adapter's message from a genuine second observation by a different adapter.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

primary_document.description: Filename of the primary document within the submission, when the adapter already knows it. The daily index does not report it, so intake resolves it after the fact.
primary_document.title: Primary Document

ticker.description: Ticker when known. Most EDGAR filers have none; null is normal.
ticker.title: Ticker

title: FilingDetected
